domain: MF/HF noise, interference and equipment effects

criteria.reason: Distinguishes source and equipment terms and conditions across regimes.
Labels predecessor calculations; contrasts published measurements with caveats. Current v18 status/scope independently confirmed.
Reference-plane and single-curve bandwidth calculations are sound; no independent multi-component sum/dependence example or receiver conversion.
Primary VLF marginal evidence and limitations, but no comparable MF/HF APD/event-model analysis.
Conceptual distinction is correct; no inspected quantitative HF occupancy/congestion comparison or operation denominator.
Correctly orders front-end stages and separates external/internal terms.
Mechanisms and proposed measurements are sound; no worked receiver-order/blocker response result.
Effects are named and uncalibrated, but no quantitative timing/filter/phase scale check is shown.
VLF and microwave cases remain distinct; idealized lunar beam calculation independently reproduced.
Good conditional recommendations and falsifiers; no paired receiver/no-signal ablation was executed.
Target calibration boundary is explicit; calculations run, but no noise product analysis, transfer comparison or source-model discriminator.
